# netactuate_platform_maintenance_info (Data Source)

Reads a Platform Maintenance Info.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_platform_maintenance_info" "example" {
  maintenance_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `maintenance_id` (Number) Platform maintenance entry ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `raw_json` (String) Complete platform maintenance response as JSON.
